definitions.gloss: to come to mind; to occur to
definitions.explanation: For an idea, memory, or image to suddenly enter one's thoughts.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{思|おも}い{浮|う}かんだ。
examples.english: A good idea came to mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{思|おも}い{浮|う}かばない。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{思|おも}い{浮|う}かんだ。
examples.english: Hearing those words, the scenery of my hometown came to mind.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
Pair: ⟦{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる→思い浮かべる：06980_omoiukaberu⟧ (transitive - to recall, picture)
Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{思|おも}い{浮|う}かぶ

VERB STRUCTURE:
⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to think) + ⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧ (to float up) = to float up in one's mind

ASPECT (ている):
{思|おも}い{浮|う}かんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ - is in one's mind (continuous state)

NEGATIVE FORM:
{思|おも}い{浮|う}かばない - can't think of, doesn't come to mind
This negative form is very common when expressing inability to remember or imagine.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧ - to come to mind
- ⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧ - to remember, recall
